subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: For this generated-media wake-false fallback PR, should maintainers accept the July 2 internal-path Mantis artifact plus scheduler tests, or require visible/diagnostic gateway-channel proof before merge?
rationale: The patch is a plausible and focused code fix, but the real-behavior proof gate cannot be settled deterministically because the current Mantis artifact says normal Telegram Desktop interaction cannot expose the path and produced no baseline/candidate visual delta.

options.title: Require visible or diagnostic proof
options.body: Ask for a proof-stack Mantis artifact, redacted logs, terminal output, or channel recording that shows baseline missing/blocking the generated media and candidate delivering it exactly once.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: Treat the July 2 Mantis manifest and scheduler matrix as sufficient for this internal failure mode while explicitly owning the lack of visible Telegram evidence.

options.title: Pause for proof harness
options.body: Keep this PR draft or paused until the proof-harness/stack work can produce a clearer baseline/candidate artifact without changing the production merge boundary.

recommendation.title: Require visible or diagnostic proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a proof-stack Mantis artifact, redacted logs, terminal output, or channel recording that shows baseline missing/blocking the generated media and candidate delivering it exactly once.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has adjacent history in async media direct delivery and is a reasonable maintainer-side owner for deciding whether the remaining proof gap is acceptable.
